properties.name: MinVerTagPrefix
properties.doc: MinVer: the prefix of the version tags, e.g. v.

properties.name: MinVerMinimumMajorMinor
properties.doc: MinVer: the lowest major.minor, for the first release of a new line.

properties.name: MinVerDefaultPreReleaseIdentifiers
properties.doc: MinVer: the prerelease identifiers of a commit after a release tag, alpha.0 by default.

properties.name: MinVerAutoIncrement
properties.doc: MinVer: which part grows after a release tag.

properties.name: MinVerBuildMetadata
properties.doc: MinVer: build metadata appended to the version.

properties.name: MinVerIgnoreHeight
properties.doc: MinVer: do not add the number of commits since the tag.

properties.name: MinVerSkip
properties.doc: MinVer: do not compute the version (e.g. in Debug).

properties.name: MinVerVerbosity
properties.doc: MinVer: how much it logs.

properties.name: MinVerVersionOverride
properties.doc: MinVer: use this version instead of the computed one.

properties.name: GenerateGitVersionInformation
properties.doc: GitVersion: generate the GitVersionInformation class.

properties.name: UpdateAssemblyInfo
properties.doc: GitVersion: write the version attributes.

properties.name: UpdateVersionProperties
properties.doc: GitVersion: set Version, PackageVersion and the rest.

properties.name: DisableGitVersionTask
properties.doc: GitVersion: do not run at all.

properties.name: PublishRepositoryUrl
properties.doc: SourceLink: put the repository URL into the package.

properties.name: EmbedUntrackedSources
properties.doc: SourceLink: embed the sources git does not track (generated files) into the PDB.

properties.name: EmbedAllSources
properties.doc: Embed every source file into the PDB.

properties.name: ContinuousIntegrationBuild
properties.doc: A deterministic build with normalized paths; set on the CI only: it breaks local debugging.

properties.name: DeterministicSourcePaths
properties.doc: Map the source paths to /_/; implied by ContinuousIntegrationBuild.

properties.name: EnableSourceLink
properties.doc: false: no SourceLink (it is built into SDK 8+).

properties.name: EnableSourceControlManagerQueries
properties.doc: false: do not ask git for the repository information.

items.name: SourceRoot
items.doc: A root of the sources for deterministic paths and SourceLink; Include ends with a slash.

metadata.name: SourceLinkUrl
metadata.doc: The URL the files under the root are downloaded from, with * for the path.

items.name: EmbeddedFiles
items.doc: Source files embedded into the PDB.
